invariants.rationale: Returning a non-null List<WriteStatus> is standard postcondition for collection returns.
instantTime is likely required downstream and passed into further methods.
Input record list should be non-null given the method contract and JDK/collection usage.
If there were no records input, there should also be no write results—or else results are always empty only if preppedRecords is empty.
Each WriteStatus should correspond to at most one input record, or fewer if some were filtered or merged.
